title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S29 E06 — Living Dead on La Brea
Zak investigates a former girl's school in Hollywood, Calif., after a gardener discovers bones in a shallow grave; could the remains be connected to sightings of a ghostly girl? Or is something more malevolent at play?

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S29 E05 — Mystery of Rispin Mansion
The crew gains unprecedented access to the cursed Rispin Mansion in Capitola, California; sealed shut after a violent paranormal event in 2012, the abandoned home has become a vault of concentrated evil, waiting for an opportunity to explode.

title: Ghost Adventures: Devil's Den
description: The Ghost Adventures crew unlocks an inhuman darkness inside a shuttered juvenile hall.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S31 E01 — Factory of Fear
Zak and the crew must separate fact from fiction as they investigate strange goings-on inside a Las Vegas warehouse; now operating as a horror-themed escape room, the site's sinister mob history has left behind a foreboding aura of violence and fear.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S29 E02 — The Houdini Seance
On the 100th anniversary of Harry Houdini's midnight visit to the fabled Winchester Mystery House, Zak and a team of paranormal experts attempt to summon the magician's spirit; will escaping death's grip be Houdini's greatest trick?

title: Harpoon Hunters
description:
S01 E06 — Keep Your Enemies Closer
With the advantage of spotter planes, veteran Tyler and young gun Joe battle for the most monster bluefin until Joe helps strongman Niko get back into contention; when Niko's zapper fails, Tyler steps in to save the day.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E05 — Twice Bitten, Twice Shy
When Sig's fishing information falls into the wrong hands, he deals his protégé a lesson he won't soon forget; Rick faces a gun-shy deckhand; Sophia contends with a crewman with a badly infected tooth.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S05 E07 — The Lowest Load
A random inspection of travelers leads to the takedown of a cartel stash house; a young woman coming from northern Mexico unwittingly brings across an illicit load; a man is detained for an outstanding warrant he didn't know he had.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S06 E09 — On the Rocks
When a man waiting in the pedestrian line to enter the U.S. suddenly turns and sprints back toward Mexico, officers give chase; a Mexican national seeks asylum in the U.S. after claiming he was kidnapped and extorted for information by cartels.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S06 E04 — Stink Bug Salsa
When two sisters are pulled over for making an unsafe lane change, officers discover they have an illicit stash that can't cross the border; a Mexican couple attempts to bring a bag of foul-smelling insects for a special recipe.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S07 E03 — The Tooth of the Matter
A woman claims she drove 13 hours for a 15-minute dentist appointment, but she can't remember the name of the dentist, and has no proof of her visit; two men returning from a night in Mexico are pulled over.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S07 E06 — The Dreaded Detroit Return
A man traveling with his young daughter attempts a U-turn before the border and comes face-to-face with CBP officers; a stand-up comedian is stopped after declaring prescription meds, but analysis shows that the pills test positive for fentanyl.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S07 E05 — Death Incarnet
When an American band is denied entry into Canada due to incorrect paperwork, CBP officers have to investigate; a U.S. citizen coming back from Mexico is flagged as having an arrest warrant, and while officers dig deeper, she attempts to escape.

title: MythBusters
description:
S15 E07 — Bullet Baloney
Firearm clichés; firing a bent-barreled shotgun; firing a gun in space; dropping a gun in a deep fryer; stopping a bullet with weird items; shooting a neon sign.

title: MythBusters
description:
S18 E05 — Supernatural Shooters
Adam and Jamie investigate the ability of hit men to take down a target.

title: MythBusters
description:
S07 E06 — Exploding Bumper
The teams test two myths of locomotion from the reliable horse to the sometimes-unreliable motor car.

title: MythBusters
description:
S07 E18 — Myth Evolution
The team takes five fan favorites and focuses on a new facet for each.

title: MythBusters
description:
S14 E03 — Down and Dirty; Earthquake Survival
Testing a bathroom hand dryer vs. using paper towels; the cleanest bathroom stall; the best place to stand during an earthquake.

title: MythBusters
description:
S14 E08 — Duct Tape Canyon
Jamie and Adam are lost in the wilderness with only duct tape and bubble wrap; they must survive the desert, repel down canyon cliff-faces and brave Class 5 rapids.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S10 E08 — Pile Jacketer; Concrete Cleaner
Mike Rowe submerges in a murky Florida river to pour concrete jackets around crumbling bridge pilings; in North Carolina, Mike sucks out a concrete washout pit and sprays sediment as he turns toxic sludge into potable water.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S10 E10 — Baghouse Cleaner; Biochar Maker
Mike Rowe attends a dusty baghouse party to clean the filtration system at a North Carolina asphalt plant; in Colorado, Mike gets his dirtiest yet, pyrolyzing waste lumber into the planet's most efficient fertilizer: biochar.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S09 E01 — Rodbuster; Galvanizer
Mike works his hardest construction job yet; he helps a team of rod busters, who carry 2 tons of reinforced steel each for overpass construction.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S10 E02 — Feral Cat Fixer; Reaper Keeper
Mike Rowe helps cat ladies of northern Texas to fix a clowder of feral cats at a spay and neuter facility; Mike and his crew feel the burn as he processes peppers with the mad scientist inventor of the Carolina Reaper.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S09 E05 — Escalator Maintainer; Scorpion Sweeper
Mike Rowe crams into a hockey arena's escalator, where he scrapes and cleans a special kind of shmutz from the bottom; Mike and a zookeeper venture into the hot, treacherous Arizona desert at night to round up stinging scorpions.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S09 E06 — Combat Surgeon; Iguana Hunter
Mike trains as a trauma surgeon, learning under simulated battlefield conditions; Mike helps to control iguanas on the Florida coast.

title: Extreme Detailing
description:
S01 E01 — Supercar in a Living Room
Master detailer Larry Kosilla turns a clean-freak obsession into a superpower, inventing cleaning techniques to transform forgotten barn finds and discarded daily drivers into high-dollar machines.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E06 — The Purpose of Porpoises
Captain Sig contends with a man overboard for the first time in his career; Johnathan comes up short on crab but sees the tide turning when thousands of porpoises guide the Time Bandit in a new direction; Jack tangles with Wild Bill.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E11 — Cleaning Up in Vegas
Rick plows through Vegas Valley pay dirt and makes a big score, but an obstacle threatens to stall him; Parker's four-plant blitz stumbles; to keep his hot streak going, Tony pilfers more gear from his son Mike.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E12 — On Shaky Ground
Parker drops the hammer as he tries to stop his gold slide; Rick makes a discovery that could end his Vegas Valley dreams; Kevin hires a new free agent and makes a big score at his new Sphinx Cut.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E13 — Valhalla or Bust
Rick makes a $1M call to open a new cut; Parker tasks Brennan with delivering more gold on Indian River; Tony re-engineers Paradise Hill's water system to get sluicing.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E14 — The Defectors
Tony's crew defects to Parker's side; Tony relies on inexperienced operators; Parker's new hires cause friction within the team; the group faces animosity as they open a new cut.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E15 — Trommel Around and Find Out
Tony blows up at Mike to get the trommel running; two of Rick's crew face off while trying to dig out Valhalla; Kevin leans on Buzz to get more gold.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E16 — The Silence of the Sluice
Parker does the unthinkable to get all the Golden Mile's pay dirt; Rick's mechanic Ryan considers leaving; Mike Beets finally fires up the trommel on the hill.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E17 — Rick's Mess
Rick's shaken by his find at the bottom of Valhalla; Tony bears down on his 6,500-ounce goal; Parker taps Brennan for a big job at the Golden Mile.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E18 — Golden Goose, Wounded Moose
Tony spends millions on a new piece of ground for Mike; Parker buys a Golden Goose to turn the season around; Kevin struggles with a recent hire.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E19 — Dig Deep or Cash Out
Rick returns to Vegas and gets a proposition from Parker; Tony hunts for missed gold in the Hester Cut; Parker's crew loses a truck at the worst time.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E20 — Musical Washplants
Parker brings Sluicifer out of retirement for a big week. Rick prays that Vegas Valley still pays out big. Kevin staffs up for the final push.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E21 — 1,000-Ounce Week
Tony guns for over 1,000 ounces in one week; Parker buys a new toy to open even more ground; Rick's crew burns through pay following a hot streak.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E22 — The Gold Ceiling
Parker and Tony both try to bust through the 10,000-ounce barrier; Rick tries to get the Last Chance cut open before he runs out of Vegas Valley pay dirt.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E23 — Klondike Shoot-Out
Parker battles Tony in an intense showdown for the year's top gold haul; Rick grinds at Lightning Creek and expands his operation to save his season.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E01 — The Most Gold Wins
Parker and Tony set 13,000-ounce gold totals, sparking a battle to see who can mine the most and reigniting an old feud; Rick faces health issues and an uncertain future; a new player enters the Klondike fray.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S06 E08 — Double Trouble
A familiar miner in Alaska desperately needs 150 ounces of gold to save their operation; when Juan learns that their landowner's mine is halfway to $1M in the hole, he and Gold Rush legend Dave Turin face their first-ever double rescue.

title: Ghost Adventures: House Calls
description:
S03 E05 — Insidious in Indiana
Zak's team lands in the Hangman's corner neighborhood of Seymour, Indiana, to answer a call from a desperate family; with the spiritual activity becoming more aggressive by the day, the guys race to find answers before someone is seriously injured.

title: Auction Kings
description:
S01 E01 — Vampire Hunting Kit; Meteorite
Gallery 63 owner Paul Brown verifies a vampire killing kit; Jon finds a signed edition of Gone with the Wind and a WWII Nazi Handbook on his first test run; a hopeful seller brings in a Russian meteorite.

title: Live to Farm
description:
S04 E01 — To Bee or Not to Bee
It's watermelon planting season! The Cardinal family shows us the importance of pollination using honey bees, and provides a tour of their farming operation. Kevin's equipment seems to break down at the worst time possible.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
Ferreting Out the Problem
Each year, CBP officers inspect thousands of animals, including family pets and exotic wildlife -- because at the border, the threat may come from a different species. Some look innocent, while others carry hidden dangers.

title: Major League Fishing
description:
Stage Seven Championship Round: Lake Erie
The Stage Seven Championship Round of Major League Fishing's Bass Pro Tour from Sandusky, OH, where the final 10 anglers compete for the trophy and a top prize of $125,000.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E01 — Life, Liberty and Tax-free Liquor
Demand spikes for Tim and Tickle's duty-free shine, but big profits breed competition in the Virginia backwoods; Mark and Digger buy 90,000 bushels of surplus corn, but must run stills 24/7 to empty the grain silos in 60 days.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S03 E07 — Cracking the D.B. Cooper Case
Josh Gates sets off on an expedition to crack the mystery behind the perpetrator of the only unsolved plane hijacking in U.S. history.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S04 E04 — The Secret
Josh travels across the United States to find the treasures featured in the cryptic 1982 book "The Secret"; Josh meets with members of the book's cult following, who each think they are on the verge of locating one of the 10 remaining treasures.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S10 E06 — The Bootlegger's Millions
Josh Gates chases the lost fortune of Prohibition's infamous bootlegger Dutch Schultz; Josh dives the murky shore near Dutch's lavish New York mansion and searches the underground bunker that housed his secret distillery.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S12 E05 — Chasing Bonnie and Clyde
Tracking America's most infamous couple, Josh teams up with a former FBI agent to scour a legendary Bonnie and Clyde hideout; then Josh hits the road on a 700-mile trip through the heartland to the site of the outlaw duo's most notorious shootout.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S10 E05 — Knights Templar Treasure Hunt
Josh digs in to unearth the secret world of the Knights Templar, the legendary warriors rumored to have amassed vast riches and treasures, including the coveted Holy Grail; Josh joins an excavation of a rare Templar gravesite in Eastern Europe.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S11 E06 — Hunt for Spain's King Arthur
Plunging hundreds of feet below ground, Josh explores Spain's treacherous La Garma cave system and finds a floor littered with human remains more than 1,000 years old; Josh's deep dive is a quest for scientific proof of Spain's legendary King Pelayo.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S15 E03 — No Gear, No Fear
A backpacker and experienced hunter attempt to survive 21 days in a swampy Argentine savanna teeming with mosquitoes and violent subtropical storms.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S18 E02 — Couch to Cave
A superfan teams with a supermom to take on the jungles of Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula for 14 days. Battling brutal storms, ravenous bats and unrelenting hunger, they must rely on sheer grit to survive this fan challenge.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S17 E11 — Poison Control
Crippled by injuries and toxic frogs, an adrenaline junkie and a self-proclaimed renaissance redneck must dig deep to try to endure 21 days in Colombia.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S18 E03 — Return of the King
Legend Steven Lee Hall Jr. joins two first-time survivalists for 21 days in the brutal backwoods of Kentucky; its deadly copperheads and violent storms push even the King of the Forest to his breaking point.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S15 E01 — Welcome to America!
Two foreigners try to become the first survivalists to endure 21 days on U.S. soil; rattlesnakes, unfamiliar terrain and plummeting temperatures threaten to send them back across the pond.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E07 — Forged in Fury
As the first Siberian storm slams the grounds, Sig sets into 40-knot winds, risking capsizing when his tank floods; Sophia must prove she can drive a boat and lead her crew in severe weather while Jake battles insubordination from his own new crew.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E08 — Seaborne Sacrifice
Sig deploys tactics from the old country to zero in on the Bairdi crab mother lode; Jack earns a windfall of new quota, but it comes at the cost of drug testing his crew.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E01 — The Tesla Terrorizer
A woman is caught on camera defecating on a car; a man makes off with a tow truck, wreaking havoc through the streets of New York City.
